beatLines.text: ◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Caleb a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 4)

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
SYSTEM: "DEMONSTRATION. Give me that — Dad's Thermos. WATCH."
💛 You hold Dad's Thermos. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)
💛 You hold Dad's Thermos and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Green Thumb)

💛 You hold Dad's Thermos. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Caleb opens the pantry wide: 5× Canned soup, 5× Foraged food, 1× Fish catch. Raul, Pedro, Lena, James and 2 more eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−2,880 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 FEASTED ×2.03 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.
